evidence.description: Bounded robots.txt and XML sitemap fetch
Site check: Robots rules / site-wide Disallow

data.checked: Parsed 1 groups; root and representative public path allowed for *, Googlebot and Bingbot.
data.why: Broad rules can prevent search engines crawling public pages.
data.recommendation: Confirm intended visibility, remove unintended broad Disallow rules, then retest.

data.why: Unintended noindex on home or key pages prevents those pages appearing in search.
data.recommendation: Confirm intended indexing per URL; inspect response headers on unsampled pages. Remove noindex only on pages intended for search.

evidence.description: Site check: Duplicates, headings / internal links

data.checked: Duplicate title groups: 0; duplicate description groups: 0; heading issues: 0; broken internal links: 0; unavailable links: 0; internal redirects: 0. Inbound links: NOT ASSESSED (incomplete sampled link graph).
data.why: Distinct metadata, logical headings and direct internal links improve navigation and help crawlers interpret pages.
data.recommendation: Use distinct titles/descriptions, fix heading jumps and broken links, link directly to final targets. Retry unavailable links before classifying them. Verify possible orphan pages with a complete link graph.

evidence.description: Site check: Suspected CDN / firewall crawler blocking

data.checked: Normal UA HTTP 202; AI-search UA HTTP 202. Comparison inconclusive; no access controls were bypassed.
data.why: A differing response may indicate a CDN/firewall policy, rate limit or transient failure; spoofing a UA does not reproduce a verified crawler IP.
data.recommendation: Review CDN/server logs and allow intentional search access after customer approval. Verify with the real crawler; do not bypass challenges.
